name: pwsh-lsp
description: PowerShell language server (PowerShell Editor Services) hosted in PowerShell 7 (pwsh) for code intelligence in .ps1, .psm1 and .psd1 files - PSScriptAnalyzer diagnostics, hover, definitions, references, symbols and completion. Registers an LSP server only: no hooks, commands, agents or skills. Windows, Linux and macOS. Maps the same extensions as powershell-lsp, so install one of the two, never both. Needs pwsh on PATH and an unzipped PowerShell Editor Services release; the plugin does not install either.
